title: person
description: An author and/or narrator. Authors and narrators are the same entity type; a person can be both.

kind.description: What sort of entity this record names. ABSENCE MEANS "person" - the field exists to mark the records that are not one: a group credited as a unit (a full cast, a band), a corporate credit of record (a publisher's in-house imprint), or a synthetic voice - a text-to-speech production rather than an individual. Nothing infers the first three; a record only carries one when a human classified it, so an absent value is 'unclassified or an individual', never a guess. "synthetic" is the one exception: the importer writes it on the single canonical record every AI-narration credit folds onto.

librivox_reader_id.description: This person's LibriVox reader id. A LibriVox import keys readers on it, so a rerun (or a reader renamed on LibriVox) never mints a second record. Unique across the dataset (pkg/check).

librivox_author_id.description: This person's LibriVox author id (a separate namespace from reader ids). Unique across the dataset (pkg/check).

birth_year.description: The year this person was born, as a source stated it (LibriVox: an author's dob). Negative for a year BC; a value the source states but that is not a year ("alive", "c. 1500") is never written.

death_year.description: The year this person died, as a source stated it (LibriVox: an author's dod). Negative for a year BC; never before birth_year (pkg/check).
